column1: ## Repository Table R3. Phasing switch errors by minor allele count
## Description: Chromosome 22 phasing diagnostic. SD and percentage points are distinct from confidence intervals. Legacy interval columns without a documented interval method are omitted.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Minor allele count bin | Minor allele count bin for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Minimum allele count | Minimum allele count for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Maximum allele count | Maximum allele count for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Mean switch error (%) | Mean switch error (%) for the observation defined in the table description.
